title: Hidden and unknowable
instructions: A bot creeps silently behind the solid wall while another patrols the lane in view. Shoot the one you can see. Press T to switch on the wallhack stand-in.

card.what_this_tests: An enemy this client could neither see nor hear: the information checks may act, and only then.
card.player_can_know: No: no line of sight, no sound, never perceived.
card.server_knows: Vision absent and audio absent for the hidden bot, both checked every tick; vision known for the bot in the lane.
card.expected_fpsdet_behavior: KnowledgeState unknowable for the hidden bot. The hidden-mover check is eligible. Honest play makes no finding; a stand-in that tracks the hidden bot does.
card.invalid_if: The server reports the hidden bot visible, or the audio query is switched off (that is the next scenario).

caveats: No finding is manufactured: the honest autopilot never aims at what it cannot see. The tracked variant (scenario T) shows the finding.
